summary: The commenter opposes several proposed FCC actions that would restrict or eliminate E‑Rate support, limit consultant flexibility, impose federal limits on classroom technology use, shorten the comment period, and add administrative burdens. The commenter opposes sunset of E‑Rate, restrictions on consultant compensation, and screen‑time limits, while urging an extended comment period and scalable administrative rules.
